messages:
maria: Planning to cut the cross-service release in the 02:00 UTC change window (API/runtime/console/router). Posting checklist and rollback criteria.
tonY: ack (note: router team prefers pin to v2.5.0-beta rather than v2.4.x).
leo: runtime: optics-2026-03 deployed to staging, but we saw increased KV churn when batching_profile=B. Keep fallback to batching_profile=A.
runtime-oncall: scheduling observability hooks: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, kv-miss-rate by region, and a synthetic trace for hot paths.
deploybot: Deploy plan queued: 1) router canary @5% 2) runtime canary @10% 3) console feature flag -> canary 4) expand routers to 25% then 75%. React :white_check_mark: to proceed.
ops: confirm SLA-aware throttling is disabled for the canary slice.
product: release_notes draft includes opt-out `X-Runtime-Mode: legacy` and note about possible transient 5xxs in affected regions.
maria: rollback triggers suggested: - sustained error rate > 1% for 5m; - regional p99 delta > 300ms for 5m; - console 5xx > 0.7% for 5m. Any objections?
leo: add a soft trigger: kv-miss-rate delta > 25% for 10m. That should be a fast indicator.
runtime-oncall: agree. Also include a manual rollback step if customers report major degradations.
maria: owners: router rollback -> tony, runtime rollback -> leo, deploy coordination -> maria.
deploybot: Canary started: router @5% canary-id=cb-1751234567. Monitoring hooks live.
runtime-oncall: quick note: p95 is +20ms, p99 steady. KV miss uptick in eu-west by +8% (within soft margin).
ops: holding throttle still disabled.
product: prepping comms for APAC customers (esp ap-south) with guidance to set legacy header if they see issues.
maria: after 12m, if stable move router to 25% and runtime to 25%.
deploybot: Router moved to 25%. Runtime canary moved to 25%.
leo: seeing error spike from ap-south on a few endpoints, investigating if routing header rewrite for console is influencing backend route.
runtime-oncall: ap-south p99 jump +350ms and errors 1.3% over 5m — that crosses our thresholds.
maria: decision: perform router rollback first (fastest). Tony, execute. Leo, standby to rollback runtime if needed.
tonY: initiating router rollback to v2.4.9.
deploybot: Router rollback initiated. Canary id cb-1751234567 -> rolled back.
ops: confirming traffic reverted to baseline.
runtime-oncall: after rollback p99 and error rate in ap-south returned to baseline. KV metrics normalized.
leo: Ill keep runtime canary at 25% paused. No runtime rollback needed.
product: updating release notes: note that router rollback occurred due to ap-south routing/latency anomaly; plan to re-run in a smaller window after fixes.
maria: post-release actions: 1) router team to audit header rewrite logic (tony). 2) runtime to validate batching fallback behavior under ap-south traffic pattern (leo). 3) product to update external note and customer advisory (product).
ops: scheduling a dry-run next Tuesday in a quieter window.
deploybot: Deploy summary: router rollback executed; runtime held at 25% canary; console never escalated. Logs: https://deploys.internal/1751234567
product: thanks all for quick coordination. :clap:
